title: Pulp comic
when: Origin stories, action and stakes, myth-busting, anything that wants the punch of a 1938 newsstand cover

voice.style: brisk radio-serial announcer, warm and urgent

rules: Every shape is printed: flat process colour a few pixels off register under a black key line (stroke ink, width 5–7). The canvas print default does this; set print: false on anything that must stay clean, such as a chart.
Tints are Ben-Day dots, not opacity: a pale sky is paper with accent2 dots (print {screen: dots, ink: accent2, tone: 0.25}); a shadow is a darker dot ramp.
One action per panel. Draw the force (benday-burst, speed lines, an impact star) and cut to the next panel on the hit; panel transitions between chapters.
Type is condensed caps in boxes, the way covers announced a feature: a caption box with an ink outline, never floating body text.
Keep numbers native and sourced; the comic look is for the frame, not the evidence.
